verdict.rationale: Chargebee's docs say subscription state changes are recorded as events (e.g. `subscription_cancelled` when a subscription is canceled for non-payment), and configured webhooks fire on those events. A community user independently confirms using multiple webhook URLs so that all events reach each environment. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the renewal, upgrade, and payment-failure event types, and of reliability guarantees (webhook retries, ordering, signature verification, deduplication)
